The '''Thela system''' was located in the [[Aparo sector/Legends|Aparo sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It shared its name with the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Pride of Thela]]''.<ref name="NJO">''[[The New Jedi Order: Edge of Victory I: Conquest]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Thela [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square R-4.<ref name="TEA" />
